title: The pro-etale sheaf exceptional-image construction
statement:
Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion with complementary open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow T$ (so $j(U)=T\setminus i(Z)$), in the scheme conventions of [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with the discrete topology. For $S=T,U,Z$, write $A_S=A_{S,\mathrm{Proet}}$ for the coefficient ring sheaf and $\operatorname{Mod}(S_{\mathrm{Proet}},A)=\operatorname{Mod}(A_S)$ for the category of module sheaves defined in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. In particular these are modules over the coefficient ring sheaf, not a separately chosen category of fixed-category-valued sheaves.

Use the canonical coefficient isomorphisms $c_u:u^{-1}A_T\xrightarrow{\sim}A_S$ of [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map], for $u=j,i$ and $S=U,Z$ respectively. Let $j^*,j_*,i^*$ be the underived module inverse and direct images of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] with these coefficient identifications. Write $\eta:\operatorname{id}\to j_*j^*$ for the unit of its module adjunction $j^*\dashv j_*$.

For $N\in\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\mathrm{Proet}},A)$ set
$$
K_N=\ker_{\operatorname{Mod}(A_T)}(\eta_N:N\longrightarrow j_*j^*N),\qquad i^!_0N=i^*K_N.
$$
The kernel is the sectionwise module kernel of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]: on each object $W\to T$ its sections are the sections $s\in N(W)$ with $\eta_N(W)(s)=0$, with the inherited $A_T(W)$-action and restrictions.

For an $A_T$-linear sheaf morphism $f:N\to N'$, let $K(f):K_N\to K_{N'}$ be the restriction of $f$ to these kernels, equivalently the unique kernel map satisfying $\kappa_{N'}\circ K(f)=f\circ\kappa_N$, where $\kappa_N:K_N\to N$ is the kernel inclusion. The defining commutative square is
$$
\eta_{N'}\circ f=(j_*j^*f)\circ\eta_N.
$$
Define $i^!_0(f)=i^*(K(f))$. This specifies the functor
$$
i^!_0:\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\mathrm{Proet}},A)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Mod}(Z_{\mathrm{Proet}},A).
$$
No exceptional adjunction or constructibility property is part of this construction.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a
closed immersion
with complementary open immersion $j$, and let $A$ be a
finite commutative ring. For a
pro-etale module sheaf
$N$ on $T$, set

$$
i^!_0N=i^*\ker\bigl(N\longrightarrow j_*j^*N\bigr).
$$

The map in this formula is the unit of the open
inverse-image and
direct-image adjunction. A morphism of sheaves induces a
map of these kernels and then its closed inverse image;
this specifies the functor on morphisms.

The morphism clause is elementary: naturality of eta, the kernel inclusion being mono, then the functor laws of i^*.
